layers_that_refused.reason: no market table. src/agent_inputs.py refuses to assemble a comparer directory without input_market.json, and src/market.py requires a --prices directory of daily series. There is no price interface on main -- src/prices is the unmerged row 'one price interface, three backends' -- and the only price fixtures committed are SPY, XLI and the synthetic delisted ZZZZ, none of which is NVDA. Both price backends are also unconfigured: TIINGO_TOKEN is unset in the run's environment and ~/.pgpass is absent, so even the read-only probe reports unconfigured. A comparer directory assembled before its inputs exist holds the right shape and the wrong run, which is what the refusal says.
